textbookBox.concept: If you could whisper one wish for your best friend, what would it be? This short poem by Jill Wolf is a prayer for friendship.

beats.en: If you could whisper one wish for your best friend, what would it be? This short poem by Jill Wolf is a prayer for friendship. It has only a few lines, but each line describes a quality of a good friend.
beats.speakEn: If you could whisper one wish for your best friend, what would it be? This short poem by Jill Wolf is a prayer for friendship. It has only a few lines, but each line describes a quality of a good friend.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · A Friend's Prayer · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: The book gives three sentences: I wish my friend brings idli in her tiffin, I hope we win the race, and may my friend get well soon.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The book gives three sentences: I wish my friend brings idli in her tiffin, I hope we win the race, and may my friend get well soon. The third is closest to a prayer because it asks sincerely for someone's good.
beats.speakEn: The book gives three sentences: I wish my friend brings idli in her tiffin, I hope we win the race, and may my friend get well soon. The third is closest to a prayer because it asks sincerely for someone's good.

beats.en: The poet wishes that friendships stay the most important thing in her life. She says that with special friends she feels blessed, which means lucky and thankful. So she asks to be able to give her very best in return.
beats.speakEn: The poet wishes that friendships stay the most important thing in her life. She says that with special friends she feels blessed, which means lucky and thankful. So she asks to be able to give her very best in return.

Rule: The poet wishes that friendships stay the most important thing in her life.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · A Friend's Prayer · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: She wants to do more than share the hopes and plans of friends who care. She promises to try all that a friend can do to make their wishes come true. These lines show that she is caring and helpful.

beats.en: She wants to do more than share the hopes and plans of friends who care. She promises to try all that a friend can do to make their wishes come true. These lines show that she is caring and helpful.
beats.speakEn: She wants to do more than share the hopes and plans of friends who care. She promises to try all that a friend can do to make their wishes come true. These lines show that she is caring and helpful.

beats.en: She asks to use her heart to see and understand what friends can be. She does not want to make judgements from afar, which means forming opinions without knowing someone well.
beats.speakEn: She asks to use her heart to see and understand what friends can be. She does not want to make judgements from afar, which means forming opinions without knowing someone well.

type: She wants to do more than share the hopes and plans of friends who care.
She asks to use her heart to see and understand what friends can be.
